slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Once two triangles are proved congruent, all of their corresponding parts are equal. We cite this as CPCTC: corresponding parts of congruent triangles are congruent. CPCTC can only be used after the congruence is proved.

Example: triangles ABD and CBD share side BD, with AB = CB and angle ABD = angle CBD. By SAS they are congruent, so AD = CD by CPCTC.
